in_sanskrit.meaning: God of mountains, youthful form of Shiva

in_hindi.long_meaning: मूर्धन्य शिव: Murdhanya Shiva, meaning 'Lord Shiva who resides at the top'

in_marathi.name: Murugasan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War and Love
